items.question: Why should one remember yoginī-bhairavas in the śrī-cakra, dear one?
premises: śrī-cakra is the locus of remembrance
the address is to the dear one
items.inference: therefore the practitioner should remember the yoginī-bhairavas in the śrī-cakra
uncertainties: the fused token saṃsmarettasmād is analyzed as saṃsmaret plus tasmād without splitting the row
items.plain_english: Therefore, dear one, one should remember the yoginī-bhairavas in the śrī-cakra.
